verdicts.reason: A: the 'Full review inside.' subcopy has shrunk to illegibly small text and sits jammed against the bottom edge of the canvas. The shoe circle is off-centre and pushed right, while the headline below is left-aligned on a different axis, so the layout feels unanchored. B: the headline is clear, prominent and well wrapped, and the logo and badge read cleanly. However, the shoe circle is shrunk and pushed to the bottom left, losing its role as the hero image. The subcopy floats beside it with no strong relationship, and an uneven band of empty space is left at the bottom.
